name: app-hand-held-phone-against-blue-sky-travel-app
title: Hand-Held Phone Against Sky
whatItIs: A hand holds a phone showing a light travel home screen, against a photographic cloudy sky, inside a thin translucent frame with pill labels above.
whatItMeans: The sky ties directly to flight themes, and the hand adds human scale. The airy palette feels optimistic.
techniques: Real hand and phone composited over a themed photo backdrop
Frosted inset frame with pill tags as metadata
Blue in the UI tinted to match the sky
Phone crop cutting off at the bottom

vocabulary.definition: A small rounded label giving year, category or discipline.
An image assembled from multiple sources.
A thin border inside the canvas edge.
